summary: The ZLauncher replacement is the session entry route: concord zl (and the zl argv[0] forwarding) resolves the named work and starts or resumes its OpenCode session through Concord's session bootstrap, with prompt pass-through, --resume-last, and --project; the interactive launcher TUI is retired under CD-0219, and the entry route stays store-write-free. ZLauncher is retired when the entry route and the accepted daily extras work on the real store.
title: the launcher is the ZLauncher replacement
